# Convertly — Free Online Document & Image Conversion Suite
> High-performance, secure, and free browser-based file conversion platform with zero data retention.

Convertly (https://convertlytools.xyz) provides 30+ native transformation engines for PDF documents, Microsoft Office files (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), and modern image formats (PNG, JPG, WebP) with optical character recognition (OCR) and AES-256 encryption.

## Technical Architecture & Privacy SLA
- **Zero-Retention Guarantee**: All uploaded source files and converted outputs are stored in ephemeral sandboxes and permanently shredded after 120 minutes.
- **No Paywalls or Hidden Limits**: 100% free with no daily task quotas, no sign-up requirements, and no watermarking.
- **Client-Grade Security**: Fully encrypted in transit via TLS 1.3 with strict CORS, CSP, and defense-in-depth isolation.

## Primary Tool Engines & Endpoints
- **PDF to Word**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/pdf-to-word — Convert PDF into editable DOCX with Tesseract OCR layout reconstruction.
- **Word to PDF**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/word-to-pdf — Convert DOCX/DOC files into standardized vector PDF documents.
- **PDF Merge**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/pdf-merge — Combine multiple PDF documents into a single consolidated file.
- **PDF Compress**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/pdf-compress — Reduce PDF file size with lossless downsampling and stream compression.
- **PDF Split**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/pdf-split — Extract page ranges or burst PDF pages into individual documents.
- **PDF Rotate**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/pdf-rotate — Permanently rotate pages 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
- **Images to PDF**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/images-to-pdf — Batch convert PNG, JPG, and WebP images into a single multi-page PDF.
- **Excel to PDF**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/excel-to-pdf — Convert XLSX and XLS spreadsheets to PDF without truncating columns.
- **PowerPoint to PDF**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/ppt-to-pdf — Export PPTX presentations to high-resolution PDF handouts.
- **PDF Delete Pages**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/pdf-delete-pages — Strip unwanted or blank pages from PDF documents.
- **PDF Extract Pages**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/pdf-extract-pages — Isolate key chapters or pages into a new PDF.
- **PDF Reorder Pages**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/pdf-reorder-pages — Visually re-sequence PDF pages with drag-and-drop.
- **JPG to PNG**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/jpg-to-png — Convert compressed JPG images to lossless PNG format.
- **PNG to JPG**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/png-to-jpg — Convert PNG graphics to compact JPG images with quality tuning.
- **Image to WebP**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/image-to-webp — Convert images to Google WebP for high-speed web delivery.
- **WebP to Image**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/webp-to-image — Unpack WebP files into universal PNG or JPG formats.
- **PDF to Images**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/pdf-to-images — Render PDF pages into high-resolution PNG or JPG images.
- **Image Resize**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/image-resize — Scale image dimensions by pixel or percentage with aspect ratio lock.
- **Image Compress**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/image-compress — Reduce image megabytes for web and email optimization.
- **Image Crop**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/image-crop — Crop images with custom aspect ratio presets.
- **Image Rotate**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/image-rotate — Rotate and flip images without quality loss.
- **PDF Protect**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/pdf-protect — Encrypt PDF documents with AES-256 password protection.
- **PDF Unlock**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/pdf-unlock — Remove user passwords and restrictions with credentials.
- **PDF Watermark**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/pdf-watermark — Stamp custom text watermarks across all PDF pages.
- **PDF Page Numbers**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/pdf-page-numbers — Insert Bates numbering and header/footer pagination.
- **PDF Redact**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/pdf-redact — Permanently blackout sensitive PII, SSNs, and financial data.
- **PDF Flatten**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/pdf-flatten — Burn interactive form fields and annotations into static vectors.
- **PDF Scrub Metadata**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/pdf-scrub-metadata — Erase EXIF, author, printer, and editing history tags.
- **PDF to TXT**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/pdf-to-txt — Extract plain text from PDF documents for NLP and search indexing.
- **PDF Grayscale**: https://convertlytools.xyz/tools/pdf-grayscale — Convert color PDF documents into monochrome black-and-white.
